analysis_md:
两边同乘 $\frac{1}{x^2}$ 可得

$$
3x\,dx+2y\,dy+\frac{y\,dx-x\,dy}{x^2}=0,
$$

即

$$
d\left(\frac{3}{2}x^2+y^2-\frac{y}{x}\right)=0,
$$

$$
3x\,dx+2y\,dy+\frac{y\,dx-x\,dy}{x^2}=0,
$$

$$
d\left(\frac{3}{2}x^2+y^2-\frac{y}{x}\right)=0,
